description.value: Fanatyk Co is a 100% Canadian-owned, locally operated ski and mountain bike shop that has been a Whistler institution since 1996, with all three original owner-riders still running the store. The shop built its reputation on expert custom ski boot fitting and freeride mountain bike service, predating the Whistler Bike Park by three years. Touring cyclists will find a fully equipped service department staffed by riders who know the local trails, carrying a broad range of mountain bike components, e-bikes, and protective gear.

address.value: 4433 Sundial Pl #6, Whistler, BC V8E 1G7, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Fanatyk Co is an active, locally-owned full-service mountain bike and ski shop in Whistler operating since 1996.
